svg.title: Prefill yields the first selection and two subsequent decode forwards yield later selections
svg.desc: A prepared prompt is processed once to produce last logits and first selection. The first selected ID becomes input to a decode forward for second selection; the second becomes input for third selection. Terminal output needs no extra forward. Arrows show dependency rather than elapsed duration.
svg.text: The first selection uses prompt logits; later steps depend on it
Prepared prompt → prefill → last logits → first selection
Populate P positions in every layer. No separate first-token decode.
First selected ID becomes input → decode → second selection
One new position per active request; read old context and append state.
Second selected ID becomes input → decode → third selection
Advance absolute position and valid cache length once.
Terminal selection → final required text + terminal record
No extra forward merely to process the final selected ID.
For g = 3: one prompt forward, two decode forwards and three selections.
Dependency diagram, not a time scale. Selection, text visibility and delivery differ.
